context: Yuki and Hiroshi-boss review a budget request.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business finance; vocabulary (一生懸命/がんばっ/取り組ん/経費/役員) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 経費の申請を、まとめました。
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員会に、いつ出すかね?
lines.en: When do we submit it to the board?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 来週、役員会に提出します。
lines.en: I'll submit it to the board next week.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 担当者は、よく取り組んでいるかね?
lines.en: Is the person in charge working hard?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 一生懸命、取り組んでいます。
lines.style: warm office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 経費は、無駄なく使ってくれ。
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 皆、がんばって節約しています。
lines.en: Everyone is working hard to economize.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: その姿勢を、役員にも伝えよう。
lines.en: Let's convey that attitude to the board too.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
